name: 共笔 TD
direction: Uppercase T and D share a single strong vertical stem: T crossbar extends left, D bowl extends right. Both letters immediately recognizable. Precise bold geometric monogram, balanced near-square silhouette. Cobalt #3159E8 and sky blue #69C7F2.

name: 留白 TD
direction: A solid rounded uppercase D contains a clearly readable uppercase T cut out in white negative space, with wide robust openings. Compact, clever and unmistakably TD, no additional symbols. Burnt orange #EE642E, charcoal wordmark.

name: 穿插 TD
direction: Two uppercase letters T and D interlock with just one intentional over-under cut at their crossing. T remains on the left and D on the right. Rounded thick strokes, coral #EF526D and apricot #FFAF86, flat shapes not gradients.

name: 小写连笔
direction: A unique lowercase td ligature drawn as one continuous broad clean stroke. Tall t stem, decisive crossbar, open rounded d bowl and ascender; both letters legible. Approachable creative identity. Violet #7942DC and raspberry #DA47A1, use two flat tones only.

name: 斜切 TD
direction: Uppercase TD letter pair compressed into a compact forward-leaning monogram. One consistent diagonal angle and one shared cut, wide confident strokes. Precise sporty energy without looking like an airline or car brand. Vermilion #EB4B2F and dark aubergine #412749.

name: 模块 TD
direction: T and D constructed from six or fewer chunky rectangular and quarter-circle blocks on one coherent grid. Letter T at left and rounded letter D at right, subtle shared boundary. Lime #BBDF3C and dark grass #438035. No additional icon, no cube, no isometric perspective.

name: 圆角 TD
direction: Soft but professional uppercase TD ligature using equal broad strokes and generous rounded inner corners. T crossbar flows directly into the top of D, D bowl is distinct. Raspberry #C62071 with rose #EF85B4. Small-size clarity is paramount.

name: 精工 TD
direction: A custom typography-driven TD monogram using subtly flared terminals, contrasting thick verticals and moderately thinner crossbars, never hairlines. Refined editorial craftsmanship, strong readable letters, contemporary not ornate. Plum #75468A and copper #D07B42.

name: 双色 TD
direction: An open uppercase D-shaped curve wraps around the right side of a bold T without obscuring either letter. One open gap separates the forms clearly. Golden yellow #F3BA21 for T and vivid violet #7050CD for D. Confident friendly playful branding, no enclosure badge.

name: 极简 td
direction: Minimal lowercase td monogram made of two visually linked but separately readable glyphs; the t crossbar aligns with the d shoulder. Large clean counters, subtle asymmetry and masterful spacing, no extra strokes. Pure ultramarine #4246E7 paired with electric coral #F87563. Make the monogram remarkably simple and iconic.
